verdict.rationale: First-party docs show llamafile running multimodal models: it describes jpg/png/gif/bmp images with Qwen3.5, Ministral3 and llava1.6 (docs-7), and its chat interface accepts images via the /upload command (docs-4). This clearly delivers the core of image-plus-text understanding. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of vision use, documentation of image input via the HTTP API/server, and detail on the range of supported vision models and their limits.
